items.title: Halchal hai fouje shaam me abbas aate hain
items.body:
Halchal hai fouje shaam me Abbas aate hai, Dariya ka ruq hai mushko alam saath laate hai.
Ghamsaan ki ladai hai sahil pe sher se, Naami jo pehelwan hai tharraye jate hai.
Sar peet kar yeh shimr pukara ghazab hua, Jo fouj ke salaar hai sab maare jate hai.
Dekho toh is jalal ki kuch inteha bhi hai, Gaisu ghazab se dosh pe bal khaye jate hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Badh kar jari ka gaiz yeh kehta hai fouj se, Hat jao pani lene ko Abbas aate hai.
Jab tak thi jang fouj se ghusse ki hadh na thi, Dariya me ghoda dal ke ab muskarate hai.
Chullu me pani lene ka shayed sabab yeh tha, Nehre furaat qabze me apne batate hai.
Alqissa bhar li mashke Sakina bhi neher se, Dariya pe pyase aaye the pyase hi jaate hai...

items.title: Kya rang laayi shaadi ibne hassan tumhaari
items.body:
KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
RAAHE KHUDA MAIN SHEH NE AISE UTHAYE SADME, AYOOB KARBALA MAIN AKAR YEH HAAL DEKHE, APNI ABA BICHA KAR SHEH CHOON RAHE HAI TUKDE, KHUSBOO KI TARHA RAN MAIN YO TERI LAASH BIKHRI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
PAIGHAME MOUT AAYA SAR SE KHULA NA SEHRA, KARNE JEHAAD HAQ PAR RAN KO CHALA THA DULHA, LADTA BHI KAB TALAK WO THA TEEN DIN KA PYAASA, TERA BARAS KE SIN MAIN UFTAAD HAIN YE KAISI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
KIS MOOSE LEKE JAYOON KHAIME MAIN TERA LAASHA, KUBRA KYA BATAOO JO HAAL HAIN TUMHARA, UJDI HAIN MAANG USKI JISKA KHULA NA KANGNA, LAMHOON KI EK DULHAN BEWA BANI HAIN BAITHI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
<<DIVIDER>>
GUL PAIRAHAN YE TERA KYA HAAL HOGAYA HAIN, SHAADI KE GHAR MEIN YAARAB YE KAISA MAREKA HAIN, DULHAN KO SAR SE PAATAK SAKTA PADHA HUWA HAIN, MATAM KADA BANA HAIN AB HUJLAYE OROOSI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
TERI BAHEN SAKINA DIL MAIN RACCHAYE ARMAAN, AATI HAIN NEK LENE DEKHO TOH USKI BEHNA, DAR PAR KHADI HAIN AKAR SHAADI KA LEKE SAMAAN, AAYEGI LAASH AISE USKO KHABAR NAHI THI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
MASNAD BICHAOO LOGO AATI HAIN LAASH NOUSHA, FARWA SE KOI KEHDE AATA HAIN USKA BETA, TAR KHOON MAIN JO DEKHA PHAT JAY NA KALEJA, KIS KAM SINI MAIN HAYE QASIM KO MOUT AAYI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI
KIS KARB KA HAIN MANZAR CHHAYI HAIN JO UDAASI, PAIHNE LIBAAS GHAMGEEN AAYE HAIN SAB BARATI, DEKHI NA PHIR JAHAAN MAIN AISI SOHAIL SHAADI, DULHA DULHAN MAIN YARAAB KAISI HAIN YE JUDAYI, KYA RANG LAYEE SHAADI IBNE HASAN TUMHARI

items.title: Maa maa hoti hai
items.body:

Aaein Fizza Tu Zahra Ne Ro Kar Kaha.
Ab Tumhare Hawalay Hai Yeh Ghar Mera.

Tum Ko Maloom Hai Mera Haal Aye Behan.
Mere Bachoon Ka Rakhna Khiyal Aye Behan.
Yeh Fizza Pukari Bataein Yeh Bibi.
Kami Kaisay Maa Ki Main Pori Karon Gi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Dekhtey Hain Tum Ko Tu Milta Hai Unn Ko Chain.
Amma Pokartay Hain Tumhein Bhi Hasan Hussain.
Main Bholi Nahi Aap Ka Ghar Chalana.
Woh Ik Waqt Mein Do Farezay Nibhana.

Kabhi Aap Ke Bin Na Guzra Koi Din.

Woh Godi Mein Le Kar Ossay Pyar Karna.
Woh Kehna Mere Lal So Ja Hussaina.

Uth Uth Ke Shab Mein Pani Pilana Hussain Ko.

Saweray Main Chehra Dhola Doon Gi Bibi.

items.title: Na tadpo Asghare Jaani badi ghareeb hai maa
items.body:
na tadpo asgher-e-jani badi ghareeb haimaa
yaha'n pa doodh na pani badi ghareeb hai maa
mai kaise dekhu'n tujhe beqaraar jhule me
na dekh uth ke mujhe baar baar jhule me

bus ab to soja mere sheerkhar jhule me
hai muqtasar si kahani badi ghareeb hai maa
nigaah phool se chehre pa jab bhi jaati hai
lahu ke ashk meri maamta bahaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bujhi na pyaas teri fikr khaaye jaati hai
aseer-e-tashna dahani badi ghareeb hai maa
fiza ne kardiya apne chaman se door hame
hai koun rakhe jo ranj o mehan se door hame

bala ne gher liya hai watan se door hame
hai waqt-e-marsiyakhwani badi ghareeb hai maa
ghareeb maa ko ye sadma bohat ziyada hai
yaha'n na sheer mayassar na aab-e-sada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanti hu'n tu yasrab ka shaahzada hai
hai panjetan ki nishaani badi ghareeb hai maa
tadap rahi hai ye maa teri pyaas ke gham me
hazarou khoon ke khatre hain deedaye nam me
<<DIVIDER>>
hai hajera ki tarha bebasi ke alam me
hai ismaeel ke saani badi ghareeb hai maa
gham ek maa ko aye akhtar na dekha jayega
kisi ke khushk labou ka khayaal aayega

hussain ibne ali ko laho rulayega
wo kehna maa ki zubani badi ghareeb hai maa

items.title: Sahil pa pada rehne de aaqa mera lasha
items.body:
waqt e akheer shaah se farmaate hain ghazi
sharminda sakina se hu'n batlaate hain ghazi
khaimon me na le jaaiye moula mera lasha
sahil pa pada rehne de'n aaqa mera lasha
<<DIVIDER>>

bas mashk o alam mere sakina ko dikhana

<<DIVIDER>>
mil jayega phir bali sakina ko naya gham

sharminda sakina se hu'n paani nahi laaya
usko na batana ke mai kyukar nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekh ke marjayegi dukhiya mera lasha
gham mera sakina nahi seh payegi dukhiya
is haal me dekhegi to marjayegi dukhiya
dekhe na kahi'n bali sakina mera lasha phir sheh ne kaha aye mere abbas e dilawar

ek baar mujhe bhai kaho mere baradar kyu'n kehte ho lejao na aaqa mera lasha
qismat ye meri mujhse kahi'n rooth na jaye
aaqa mere gham se ye kamar toot na jaye
bas chordey dariya pe burida mera lasha

items.body:

<<DIVIDER>>
Is gham sey fiza Kufay ki tharraayi huwi hai
Ab arsh pa ashkon ki ghataa chhaayi huwi hai
Aur taaron kay aankhon mein nami aayi huwi hai
Har zarre ki ashkon sey shanasaayi huwi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Gham hai kay Islam ka larzaan hai sawairaa
Sakta hai har ek gaam pa sannaaton ka deiraa
Khaamosh fizaaon mein hai har samth andheiraa
Khoon rothaa hai unnisween Ramzaan ka sawairaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Farqe ShaheyWaala huwa shaq zarbey sitam sey
Maula jo tadapney lagey Sar haathon sey thaamey
Hasnain ney roomaal kasaa sar pa Ali kay
Chehrey ko bhigothay hi bahey khoon kay dhaarey
Rothay huwey Abbas Ki Maa ney kaha Aaqa
Sadqey karun Abbas ko Tujh par sey Main Maula
Haider ney kaha yeh toh hai Shabbir ka fidiyaa
Aur hoga muhaafiz yehi Zainab ki ridaa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehney lagay Zainab sey Ali phir yeh tadap kar
Karta hoon Tujhey sabr ki talqeen Meri Dukhtar
Baazu mein rasan hoyegi chhin jaayegi chaadar
Hamraah na hoga koyi juz Abid-e-Muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
Katt jaayengay Abbas e Alamdaar kay shaaney
Lut jaayega ghar asr ko jal jaayeingay khaimey
Phailengey joonhi shaam e ghareeban kay andheiray
Beti Meri pehraa Tujhey deyna hai akeiley
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Tere aansu nahin Haider ko gawaarah
Karbal mein nahin dega Tujhe koyi dilaasa
Math ro Meri Beti kay abhi zindaa hai Baba
Phir ro diye khud shaanon ko aankhon sey lagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab sab ko Ali ney kiya Shabbar kay hawaaley
Bey chain huwey suntey hi Abbas kay naaley
Seeney sey laga kar kaha aankhon kay ujaaley
Abbas Tujhe karta hoon Sarwar kay hawaaley
<<DIVIDER>>
Aansoon nikal aaye junhi lab choomey Hasan kay
Girya kiya Sarwar kay galay kay liye bosey
Phir aakhri angdaayi li aur bachchon sey boley
Karta hoon tumhein Khaliq e Akbar kay hawaaley

items.title: Pamaal hua qasime dilgeer ka lasha
items.body:
pamaal huwa qasim e dilgeer ka laashsa
maqtal ki fizao'n me hai shabbir ka nouha
rudaad sunaye ye kisey ranj o mehan ki
hai doobi huwi khoon me tasveer hasan ki
<<DIVIDER>>
kistarha diya jayega farwa ko dilasa
talwarou'n ke hamle pa hui teerou'n ki bouchhar
bhaale kabhi barse to kabhi naizo'n ki yalghaar phir ghodo'n se rounda gaya ek pyaase ka seena
kya ajr risalat ka ye ummat ne diya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt se nargha mere qasim pa hua hai
kis kis ne kiya ek tan e mazloom pe hamla
abbas ke shagird ne ki khoob ladayi
islaam ke dushman pe ki badh badhke chadhayi
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoke se kiya us pe sitamgaar ne nargha
ek jaan ke dushman the jo har simt se aaye
zarbat koi aage koi peechhe se lagaye
kya zulm se maara gaya seh roz ka pyaasa
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat me luti hai mere bhai ki nashaani
hai khoon meghaltaa'n mere shabbar ki jawani
fariyaad sunaate hain ye karte huwe giriya
is jaa kabhi doude hai to us jaa kabhi doude
<<DIVIDER>>
ek jaa pe kabhi ruk ke ye rote huwe bole
tukdou'n me bata hai mere qasim ka janaza
mai dekh raha hu'n mere bachche ka janaza
aankho'n se tapakta hai mere khoon jigar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jeeta raha mar gaya afsos bhatija
shrminda hu'n awaaz lagata raha qasim
aajao chacha keh ke bulaata raha qasim
foujo'n ki safou'n me mujhe milta nahi rasta
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha tha jigar tumne jo tukdo'n me hasan ka
zainab ye wohi haal hai qasim ke badan ka
matam mere mazloom hasan ka huwa taaza
saqqa e haram karte hain qasim ka jo matam
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai'n turab aankhe'n azadarou ki purnam
tum sab ko dua deti hai maa fatima zehra

items.title: Yaad laila ko jawan bete ki tadpati hai

jab bhi masjid se azaano'n ki sada aati hai
roze aashoor jo maqtal me sada goonji thi
ab bhi mehfoos hai dil me wo azaa'n akber ki
<<DIVIDER>>

jis ko armanou se atthara baras pala tha
dasht me jalti zamee'n par tha usi ka lasha
siskiyaa'n leke wo zainab se lipat jaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dard aisa hai bhala khud ko sambhale kaise
jab mussale pe wo aati hai ibadat ke liye
muztarib hoti hai deewaro'n se takraati hai
shadi akber ki karu'n thi ye tammana meri
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala me hai magar lutgayi duniya meri
khud se tanhaayi me roro ke ye farmaati hai
ghar to veeran huwa jaan jo akber ne di
haa'n magar deen-e-mohammed ko jawani dedi
<<DIVIDER>>
apne dil ko yehi kehti huwi samjhaati hai
gham wo paya hai ke nazro'n me dhuwa'n hai abtak
qalb-e-madar mai jo paiwast sina'n hai abtak
kabhi roti kabhi ghash khaake wo girjaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
charsoo ab hai andhera ke ujaala na raha
haaye ghurbat ke zaeefi ka sahara na raha
sonchte sonchte ek dam se wo ghabraati hai
kya baya'n honge bhala hamse masayeb wo kamaal
<<DIVIDER>>
baad-e- akber tha qayamat umme laila ka haal
wo tadap ab bhi azadarou ko rulvaati hai

items.title: Battees baras ka saath
items.body:
Shabeer Ke Khaimay Mein Qayamat Ka Tha Manzar.
Rukhsat Ke Liye Aaye Jo Abbas-e-Dilawar.
Jab Ro Chukay Abbas Ko Seene Se Laga Kar.
Bhai Ki Taraf Dekh Ke Kehne Lagay Sarwar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Batees Baras Ka Sath Hai Na Chodiye Bhai.
Bhai Ke Liye Maut Hai Bhai Ki Judai.
Abbas Mera Dil Ho Tum Hi Jan Ho Meri.
Kya Meri Muhabbat Mein Kami Reh Gayi Koi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai Se Zyada Tumhein Pyari Hai Tarai.
Ghurbat Mein Mujhe Chor Ke Bhai Na Sidharo.
Khuwaish Hai Meri Qabar Mein Tum Mujh Ko Utaro.
Pardais Mein Ghurbat Humein Kis Moor Pe Layi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pardais Mein Shabeer Ka Hai Kaun Sahara.
Bhai Na Miley Ga Mujhe Tum Jaisa Dobarah. Kyun Chor Ke Jane Ki Khabar Tum Ne Sunai.
Ghazi Meri Behno Ko Bari Aas Hai Tum Se.
Zainab Ko Jo Dharas Hai Woh Ahsas Hai Tum Se.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Sath Ho Iss Wastay Woh Aayi Hai Bhai.
So Jao Gay Tum Bazu Kata Kar Lab-e-Darya.
Ammo Hain Kahan Mujh Se Yeh Pochay Gi Sakina.
Masooma Na Seh Paye Gi Ammo Ki Judai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jane Lagay Abbas Tu Nazron Mein Thi Chadar.
Rotay Hoye Abbas Ne Dekha Tha Palat Kar.
Jab Khaima-e-Kulsoom Se Aawaz Yeh Aayi.
Aaya Nahi Phir Laut Ke Saqa-e-Sakina.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Gurz Laga Sar Pe Kaha Haye Sakina.
Shabeer Chaley Khaimay Se De De Ke Duhai.
Darya Pe Kamar Tham Ke Jab Pohanchay Sirhaney.
Ghazi Se Kaha Ro Ke Sheh-e-Karb-o-Bala Ne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Aap Ki Furqat Ne Kamar Meri Jhukai.
Zeeshano Raza Toot Gayi Aas Haram Ki.
Dam Toor Gaye Shah Ki Aagosh Mein Ghazi.
Shabeer Yeh Kehte Rahe Bhai Mere Bhai.

items.title: Dulha ki laash sarwar maqtal se la rahe hai
items.body:
APNI ABA BICHA KAR TUKDE UTHA RAHE HAIN, DULHA KI LAASH SARWAR MAQTAL SE LA RAHE HAIN
HAR GAAM SONCHTE HAIN FARWA KO KYA BATAO, PAMALIYE BADAN KI RUDAD KYA SUNAO, KIS TARHA LAASHE QASIM KHAIME MEIN LEKE JAYO, HAR EK QADAM PA RUKH KAR AANSU BAHA RAHE HAIN
RAAHE KHUDA MEIN QASIM JAAN APNI NAZAR KARNE, PAANE KO IZNE SHEH SE THE MUZTARIB KUCH AISE, KHUSH HOGAYE WASIYAT BABA KI MAA SE SUNKE, TAWEEZ APNI LAKAR SHEH KO BATA RAHE HAIN
SEHRAYE KARBALA MEIN SHAADI RACHI YE KAISI, HAIN TEEN DEEN KE PYASE JISME SABHI BARATI, SHADI KE GHAR MEIN HAR SU CHAYI THI EK UDASI, BETI KO APNE SARWAR BEWA BANA RAHE HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
SHAADI KI JAA PA MATAM ALLAH KYA SAMA HAI, RANJ-O-ALAM MEIN DOOBA PYASO KA KARWAN HAI, FARWA KE DIL KA YARAAB YEH KAISA IMTEHAAN HAI, MASNAD BICHI HUI HAI DULHA KO LA RAHE HAI
SEHRE KI SAARI LADIYA RAN MEIN BIKHAR GAYI HAIN, SHADI KI SAARI KHUSHYA JANE KIDHAR GAYI HAIN, MANZAR LAHOO LAHOO THA NAZRE JIDHAR GAYI HAI, NOUSHAH-E- KARBALA KA SAB GHAM MANA RAHE HAIN
KUCH DER KI YEH DULHAN BAITHI HAI SAR JHUKAYE, HUM SIN HAI KOUN JISKO AB DARD-E-DIL SUNAYE, YEH DHOOP BEKASI KI YEH BEWAGI KE SAYE, JAZBE UDASIYO KA TOOFAN UTHA RAHI HAIN
IBNE HASAN KA LAASHA KHAIME MAIN AAYA JISDAM, US DAM SOHAIL BARPA THA EK SHOR-E-MATAM, AB HAAL KYA BAYAAN HO JO KARB THA ALAM, HAR DIL PA RANJ-O-GHAM KE BADAL SE CHHA RAHE HAIN...

items.title: Zulm hota hai naya dekho yaha aye abbas
items.body:
ZULM HOTA HAI NAYA DEKHO YAHA AYE ABBAS, HAI WO ZAINAB KI NIGAHAO MEIN DHUWA AYE ABBAS
EK LAMHE KI DULHAN BEWA BANI HAI BAN MEIN, GHAM SIWA HOTA HAI HO AAP KAHA AYE ABBAS
LAILA PHIR CHAND SE CHEHRE KO KAHA PAYEGI, YAAD AATI HAI MUJHE USS KI AZAAN AYE ABBAS
YAAD TADPATI HAI HAR PAL JAWAN AKBAR KI MUJHE, DIL KI DHADKAN MEIN HAI WO DARD PINHAA AYE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
PAANI KE BADLE MILA TEER-E-SITAM ASGHAR KO, PHIR NA KHOLEGA KOI APNI ZUBAAN AYE ABBAS
PHOOL SE GAAL TAMACHHOY SE HUE HAI NEELE, HAR SITAM PAR HAIN SAKINA KI FUGA AYE ABBAS
KHAT JO SUGRA KA MILA AAINE SHAHADAT SHEH KO, YAADE SUGRA MEIN THE BUS AANSOO RAWAAN AYE ABBAS
AAP KE BAAD SITAM ASHQHIYA WO DHATE HAIN, AAJ MEHSHAR SE BHI BADHKAR HAIN SAMAA AYE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
LAB KO JUMBISH THI SHAHE WALA KO BHAI KE LIYE, YAAD KARTE THE SHAHE KOUN-O-MAKAAN AYE ABBAS
WAADA EK MAA NE KIYA THA JO KABHI TIIFHLI MAIN, AAYI ZEHRA KI SADA AAGAYI MAA AYE ABBAS
SHUMR AB PYAASE GALE PAR HAI CHALATA KHANJAR, CHHODKAR BHAI KO HOO AAP KAHA AYE ABBAS
HAYE WO SHAM-E-GHAREEBA WO QAYAMAT KI GHADI, JALTE KHAIMOU SE WO UTHTA THA DHUWAA AYE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
YEHI KOOFA HAI JO THA SHAAN-E-ARAB HYDER KA, NANGE SAR BIBIYAN AAYI HAIN YAHA AYE ABBAS
HAYE BIMAAR RAHE TAUQ-O-SALASIL KA AASIR, DARD-E-DIL BANGAYE ZAKHMOU KE BAYYAN AYE ABBAS
SHAAM KE DAAL KE MAJLIS KI BINA ZAINAB NE, SAATH MEIN LAYI WATAN HAQ KE NISHA AYE ABBAS
MUMTAYEE HOKE WAHANHONGEY MERE BHAI WAHAN, TANHA SUGRA HAI MADINE YAHAN AYE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
ZIKRE ZAINAB KE SABAB DEEN BACHA HAI IQBAL, HAQ O BATIL MEIN KIYA FARQ-E-AYAAN AYE ABBAS..

Jo ke qable rasool tu ne padhi
Hai daleel ek tere imaa'n ki
Tera alhamdulillah kehna bhi
Roohe imaa'n bane tere jumle
Aayatou me dhale tere jumle
Naat goyi ke qaaliq o baani
Zaat teri hai zaat e irfaani
Tujh se zaahir hai qoo e imaani
Kulle imaan hai tera jaani
Nekh seerat hai nekh baqt hai tu
Kalma goyou ka sar parast hai tu
Log barish ki the dua karte
Tere ash'aar ke waseele se
Kibriyaai sifaat the tere
Jaari hai tere faiz ke chashme
Aap baara ke haq me heela hai
Kitna mahkoom tera waseela hai
Tujh se khaate the qouf baani e shar
Tera dar tha laeenou ke upar
Bu lahab bu jehal se taqatwar
Kaamp jate the naam ko sun kar
Kufr ka zor kuch dikha na sake
Wo mohammed pe hath utha na sake
Tha unhe yu rasool par ghussa
Bud parasti par kyu kiya hamla Kyu kaha ek hai quda sab ka Kyu padha la ilaaha ilallah
Ek dil mashr keene makka the
Dar paye jaa'n nabi ke aada the
Chahte the mitaade naame nabi
Koshish unki thi har qadam pe yahi
Tu ne jis dam nabi ki li pushti
Khal gayi unko ye ada teri
Us himaayat ka badla lete hai
Dukh tujhe aaj bhi wo dete hai
Tujhpe ilzaam kufr ka dharna
Hai saqeefaai ek mansooba
Tohmatou ke sahare par aada
Aaj tak bhi hai dar paye eeza
Qoon me unke jo najasat hai
Dil me unke teri adaawat hai
Tere dushman hai nasl e be tehqeeq
Ho chuki jin ke jhoot ki tasdeeq
Deen me ghus gaye the kuch zandeeq
Koi farooq aur koi sadeeq
Laanate unpe bheja karte hai
Momin unpe tabarra karte hai
Tera saaya jo uth gaya aaqa
Ho gaye qud rasool be saaya
Mera baba mera chacha na raha
Kehte hai roke ye rasool e quda
Kya musibat nabi pe aayi hai
Shaaq dil par teri judaayi hai
Dil se ho kar malool rote hai
Baagh e zehra ke phool rote hai
Ba safa ba usool rote hai
Tere gham me rasool rote hai
Tera ehsaa'n nibha rahe hai nabi
Teri mayyat utha rahe hai nabi
Koi hamdard tujh sa ab na raha
Gham se behaal hai rasool e quda
Hai digar haal gham se moula ka
Uth gaya sar se baap ka saaya
Aaj haq ke wali yateem huwe
Haye moula ali yateem huwe
Roye gham me tere rasool e quda
Apne hathou se tujh ko kafnaaya
Tere taaboot ko diya kaandha
Tera kis shaan se janaza utha
Jab sawaari makaan se uthhi
Teri mayyat bhi shaan se uthhi
Chot gham ki jo dil pe hai khayi
Karbala ne hai shakl dikhlaayi
Gham e sarwar ki hai fizaa chaayi
Bekasi e hussain yaad aayi
Qalb e zehra ke chain ka laasha
Bekafan tha hussain ka laasha

items.title: Qasim jo hum Shabihey janab-e-Ameer tha
items.body:
Qasim jo hum Shabihey janab-e-Ameer tha
Is wajha sey woh gheerath-e-mehray muneer tha
Aur aashiq-e-jamaal-e-Shahey bey nazeer tha
Parwaana-e-charaag Rasool-e-qadeer tah
<<MINI>>
Akbar sey kehtha tha kay chacha toh Imam hain
Aye bhaayi jaan hum toh tumhaarey ghulaam hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh kehthay thay ke tum meray daada ki shaan ho
Dil ho jigar ho aankh ho bhaayi ki jaan ho
Aye bhaayi jaan kya teri khoobi bayaan ho
Hazrat Hasan ki tarhaa sey tum shireen zabaan ho
<<MINI>>
Phir pyar se woh haathon ko gardhan mai daalkay
Kehthay thay qatl hongay hum atthaara saal kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Fouj-e-jafaa sey ithney mai teer-e-jafaa chalay
Aur yaan sey peishwaayi ko ahley wafaa chalay
Aaye Khuda ki samth sey suvey Khuda chalay
Kehthay thay Shah zor-e-muqaddar sey kya chalay
<<MINI>>
Qasim rahey aur Akbar-o-Abbas rehgaye
Satharr doh tanh main teen jawaan paas rehgaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Is gham sey jo Hussain ki haalath huvi tabaah
Tabh haath pakday khaimey mai Qasim ko laaye Shah
Zainab sey phir yeh bolay Imam-e-Falak panaah
Dar peish humko aaj hai doh beykasoun ka biyaah
<<MINI>>
Taqreeb soghvaaroun main dulha dulhan ki hai
Zainab uttho uttho yeh waseeyath Hasan ki hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ibne Hasan ko laakay libaas-e-Hasan pinhaao
Qasim ki maa ko maadar-e-Kubra ko jald laao
Woh boli jaan bhujjkay bhaiyya na yeh sunaao
Is kaam kay liye toh kisi aur ko bulaao
<<MINI>>
Maatam kay ghar sey koyi bhi jaata hai biyaah main
Betoun moyee ko koyi bulaatha hai biyaah main
<<DIVIDER>>
Jin haathoun sey kay betoun ki laashein utthaaoun main
Un haathoun sey bhateejay ko dulhaa banaaoun main
Farsh-e-aza jahaan pa ho safay maatam bichaaoun main
Kubra ko waan libaas-e-uroosi pehnaaoun main
<<MINI>>
Kyonkar bhalaa yeh ussay ho jo khairkhaa ho
Meri toh yeh dua hai mubaarak yeh biyaah ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaadash bakhair Fatema Soghra nahin yahaan
Rukhsath kay waqt kehthi thi mujsey woh naathawaan
Qasim ka biyaah huvey safar main jo naagahaan
Tum mujhko yaad karkay bulaalijiyoh wahaan
<<MINI>>
Afsous ki jagaah hai koyi naamabar nahin
Qasim ka biyaah hotha hai isko khabar nahin
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh ney kahaa bahen na tharad-dudh karo zaraa
Maatam ka apney betoun kay haan uzar hai bajaa
Yeh aqdh bhi hai fidyaa sibtey Rasool ka
Shaadi kujaa aur aal-e-Rasool-e-Khuda kujaa
<<MINI>>
Jaayega namuraad yeh dulhaa jahaan sey
Taa hashr shaadi utt gayi is khaandaan sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehthi thi yoon phupi sey Sakina kay kya hai gham
Lo bhaayi dulhaa banthay hain ab nekh leingay hum
Saamaan-e-aqdh jamaa pareishaan magar harum
Qasim ki maa pukaari fidaa aye Shahey umam
<<MINI>>
Laoundi hoon aaj sey main shahey khushqisaal ki
Shaadi Hussain karthay hain beva kay laal ki

items.body:

<<DIVIDER>>
Raitaanch Dul Gaei, Mityaanch Rul Gaei, Maa Nu Rawavay, Qasim Di Mehndi.
Kubra Da Baba Chadar Vicha Kay, Chun Chun Kay Pavay, Qasim Di Mehndi.
Maqtal Cho Syed Ey Vain Paaya, Kallah Hay Nana Zahra Da Jayaa, Kausar Kanaaray Mairay Turgay Saray, Kayra Uthavay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Kuj Mehndi Gohray Summach Lay Gay, Kuj Eyday Tukray Maqtalch Ray Gay, Syed Musafir Qasim Di Maa Ton, Keewain Lukaa Vay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Putraan Nu Lokon Sehraych Laa O, Qasim Di Pehlaa Majalis Kara O, Banray Nu Aakho Shagnaa Day Vailay, O Kad Nah Javay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Khaiyyam Andar Jadon Mehndi Aayi, Banray Di Maa Nay Sir Khaak Paayi, Banree Da Baba Bheni Bulaakay, Ro Ro Vakhaa Vay Qasim Di Mehndi.
Pehra Laga Tha Darya Pe Har Jaa, Pyasa Tha Kunbaa Pani Nhi Tha, Pani Ke Badlay Ashkon Se Goondhi, Madar Ne Haey Qasim Di Mehndi.
Tukray Huway Yu Armaan Dil Ke, Ankhon Se Uski Kyun Khoon Na Barsay, Sajjad Aaey Hain Shaam Logon, Dil Mein Basaey Qasim Ki Mehndi.
Farwa Ke Aansu Deinge Zamanat, Poori Na Hogi Kis Trha Mannat, Kubra Ke Sadqay Jab Koi Beti, Jab Bhi Uthaey Qasim Ki Mehndi.
Tauqeer O Dy Toh Sain Raazi, Mazloom-e-Karbal Di Bhain Raazi

items.title: Jaane walo dare Abbas pe tum jab jaana
items.body:
Jane Walo Dar-e-Abbas Pe Jab Tum Jana.
Yeh Areeza Mere Maula Ko Suna Kar Aana.
Sab Se Pehle Unhein Kehna Meri Janib Se Salam.
Phir Yeh Kehna Ke Tarapta Hai Watan Mein Woh Ghulam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Nahi Lana Faqat Izn-e-Ziyarat Lana.

Dekhney Hain Mujhe Rozon Ke Badaltay Parcham.

<<DIVIDER>>
Kehna Hazrat Se Wasail Ko Kushada Kar Dein.
Mera Iss Saal Zara Rizq Zyada Kar Dein.
Betiyon Beton Ko Humrah Mujhe Hai Lana.
Karbala Paison Se Jate Nahi Mujh Ko Hai Khabar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Bulatay Ho Tu Mil Jata Hai Khud Zaad-e-Safar.
Likha Ho Aana Tu Lagta Nahi Ik Bhi Aana.
Chotay Hazrat Se Yeh Kehna Ke Hai Ashor Qareeb.
Yeh Bhi Kehna Ke Kya Iss Saal Bhi Tarpay Ga Ghareeb.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khon Ka Dena Hai Waan Aa Ke Mujhe Nazrana.
Unn Se Kehna Nahi Mangoon Ga Main Asaish-o-Chain.
Neend Jab Aaye Gi So jaon Ga Bain Al Haramain.
Kafs Ko Takiya Bana Kar Hai Mujhe So Jana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Arbaeen Ki Jo Bananey Lagin Fehrist Aaqa.
Naam Mera Bhi Sakina Ke Tasadduq Likhna.
Mujh Ko Bhi Karbala Paidal Hai Najaf Se Jana.
Main Agar Sham Gaya Pehle Tu Bolon Ga Yehi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Ke Ammo Ne Bhaija Hai Sakina Pani.
Tum Abalfazl Ke Sardab Ka Pani Lana.
Kaisay Zindah Rahi Bin Aap Ke Asghar Ki Behan.
Mar Gayi Par Na Khuli Bachi Ki Gardan Se Rasan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pursa Masoom Sakina Ka Hai Deney Aana.
Mir Sajjad Ko Nohay Ka Sila Yeh Dena.
Iss Baras Karbobala Aaye Ga Jab Woh Maula.
Aap Nazranay Ke Badlay Mein Nazar Aa Jana.

items.title: Noke neza
items.body:

Dar hai kulsum ke chehre pe na parh jaaye nazar, (noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar) x2

Chashm-e-sajjad se behne lage us waqt lahu ke dhaare, jab ke masoom sakina ko sitamghar ne tamaache mare, laasha sahil pe tarapta hai udhar aur idhar, noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar

Dar hai kulsum ke chehre pe na parh jaaye nazar, (noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar) x2

Dar hai kulsum ke chehre pe na parh jaaye nazar, (noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar) x2

Dar hai kulsum ke chehre pe na parh jaaye nazar, (noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar) x2

Kabhi layla kabhi farwa kabhi kalsum kahe wawayla, chehra balon se chhupate huwe zainab ne yahi ro ke kahaa(n), amma fiza zaraa dekho to ye gham ka manzar noke neza pe teherta nahi abbas ka sar

items.title: Bhai ke gham me sheh ki kamar toot gayi
items.body:
BHAI KE GHAM MEIN SHAH KI KAMAR KI TOOTH GAYI HAI
ZAINAB KE QALB-O-CHAAK SE EK HOOK UTTHI HAI, MASOOM SAKINA PA QAYAMAT KI GHADI HAI, EHLE HARAM MEIN MATA-E-ABBAS-E-ALI HAI, SEHRAYE KARBALA MEINYAHI NOUHA GARI HAI
ABBAS KHAIMA GAH MEIN PAANI NA LAASAKE, BACHCHAY HAI INTEZAAR MEIN KUZEY LIYE HUVE, KAISE KAHAIN HUSSAIN SAKINA KE SAAMNE, ABBAS TASHNALAB LABEY DARIYA GUZAR GAYE
MASHK-O-ALAM KO LAAYE HAIN JO QAIMA GAAH MEIN, ALAM EK IZTERAAB KA HAI QALB-E-SHAH MEIN, KYA DARD-E-DIL NEHAA HAI SAKINA KI AAH MEIN, SHAAM-E-GARIBAA PHIRTI HAI SHAH KI NIGAAH MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KUCH DUM MEIN HOGI SEENAYE SHABBIR PAR SINA, BARCHI JIGAR PA KHAKE SIDHARE GA NAUJAWAN, AB HURMULA HAI TEER HAI AUR HALQ-E-BEZABAAN, HO JAYEGI ASEER NABI KI NAWASIYAAN
WO WAQT HAI KAREEB KE JALNE LAGE GA BAN, MAQTAL MEIN HONGEY LAASHEY SHAHDAO KE BE KAFAN, DAST-E-SITAM SE TADPEGI BINTE SHAH-E-ZAMAN, ZAINAB KE BAZUAOPA BANDHI JAYEGI RASAN
ZAINAB JIGAR FIGAAR KI CHADAR KI KHAIR HO, YARAB SAKINA BIBI KE GOUHAR KI KHAIR HO, BEEMAAR NATAWAN KE BISTAR KI KHAIR HO, GHURBAT MEIN FATIMA KE BHARE GHAR KI KHAIR HO
PYASI SAKINA REH GAYI SAQQA NAHI RAHA, SAQQEY KE GHAM MEIN HOTA HAI PAANI FURAAT KA, JUNGLE MEIN LUT RAHA HAI GULISTAAN-E-FATIMA, SAR PEET TI HAI KHAAQ UDATI HAI KARBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
DARBAAN-E-SHAAM MEIN MERA CHOUTHA IMAAM HAI, AUR SAR BAREHNA ZAINAB-E-AALI MUQAAM HAI, IN MANZILAO MEIN SABR TO ABID KA KAAM HAI, ABBAS KI JUDAI QAYAMAT KA NAAM HAI
JIS DAM RAFI KHAAK PA WO AASMAA GIRA, GIRNEY SE US JARI KE BURA HASHR HO GAYA, KAMZOOR FOUJ-E-SHAAM KA PHIR HOUSLA BADA, ABBAS KYA UTHAY KE QAYAMAT HUVI BAPA..

items.title: deti hai zainab sada ho kahan aye bawafa
items.body:
deti hai zainab sada ho kahan aye bawafa
hai sitam ki inteha ho kahan aye bawafa
1. aye jawano ke jawan, mere bhai ho kahan
sani-e-shair-e-quda, lashkar-e-shai ke jawan
aye alamdar-e-wafa, mere baba ke nashan
ab nahi koi mera, ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. haye jab mazloom ke seene par naiza laga
wo faras ki pusht se dagmaga kar gir pada
saamne mere chala kund khanjar shimr ka
de rahi thi mein sada ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ab na bache hai mere aur na hain qasim yaha
margaya ran mein mera haye wo kadiyal jawan
teer khakar zulm ka chal basa hai bezaban
hain na koi aasra ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
4.qatl sare hogaye koi yara na raha
puchne wala koi ab hamara na raha
jis se dhaaras thi mujhe wo sahara na raha
kya kare bahene bhala ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. mashk lekar kya gaya phir na aaye laut kar
kya nahi lena tumhe apne bahena ki qabar
tum ne yeh soncha nahi hoga kya iska asar
chin gayi sar se rida ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
6. tere marne se jari har sitam mujh par huwa
raat din karti hoon mein, apne marne ki dua
tune ki aysi wafa naaz karti hai wafa
aye wafaoun ke khuda ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. muntazir teri rahi haye nazoun ki pali
rah takti hi rahi haye nazoun ki pali aur wo pyasi rahi haye nazoun ki pali
tumko deti thi sada ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. gham ki ek tasveer thi shaam ke zindan mein
har sitam sehti rahi shaam ke zindan mein aur wo ghut kar margayi shaam ke zindaan mein
haal toh dekho zara ho kahan aye bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
9. dekh kar zulm-o-sitam muztarib thi bebiyan
jal chuke qayme sabhi tha fazaon mein dhuwan
rokle sarwat qalam rok le apna bayan
thi fazaon mein sada ho kahan aye bawafa

items.title: Maqtal se aaraha hai gulgoo qaba ka laasha
items.body:
MAQTAL SE AA RAHA HAI GULG00 QABA KA LAASHA
QAIMO'N MEIN SHAHE DEE'N KE EK HASHR SA HAI BARPA.
1. JIS DAM SADA E QASIM asws. MAQTAL SE AAYI SHEH KO.
MAIDA'N MEIN DAUDE SARWAR asws. KEHTE HUE YEH DEKHO.
ABBAS asws. AUR AKBAR asws. AB RAN KO JALD POHONCHO.
TAB TAK HASSAN asws. KA DILBAR PAAMAL HO CHUKA THA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ALLAH KYA GAZAB KA ASHOOR KA WO DIN THA.
DULHAN BANI THI KUBRA sa. QASIM asws. BANA THA DULHA.
KARNE JIHAAD RAN KO POHONCHA HASSAN asws. KA BETA.
SHIDDAT KI TISHNAGI MEIN KAB TAK SAHEGA HAMLA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. PANI KAHA'N SE LAAYE SHIDDAT KI TISHNAGI MEIN.
SHARBAT BANAYE KAISE SHADI KI IS QUSHI MEIN.
KAISA YEH GHAM HAI AAYA KUBRA sa. KI ZINDAGI MEIN.
LAMHO'N KA EK DULHA APNI DULHAN SE BICHDA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. SHADI KI JAA PA MATAM SHADI KA HO RAHA HAI.
ODHE HUE WO DULHAN MAILI SI EK RIDA HAI.
QUSHIYO'N KA HAAYE PAL MEIN MANZAR BADAL GAYA HAI.
AANSOO BAHA RAHI HAI SAR KO JHUKAYE KUBRA sa.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. THI MAA KI YEH WASIYAT ZINDA NA RAN SE AANA.
AY MERE LAAL APNA WAADA NA BHOOL JAANA.
BABA KI AB NIYABAT TUMKO HI HAI NIBHANA.
ZINDA TO JAA RAHE HO QAIME MEIN AAYE LAASHA.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. POHONCHE JO SHAH RAN KO MUSHKIL KI WO GHADI THI.
MAIDAN E KARBALA MEIN QUSHBOO GULO'N KI MEHKI.
BIKHRI HUI JO RAN MEIN SEHRE KI HAR KALI THI.
APNI ABAA MEIN LAASHA CHUNTE HAI SHAHE WAALA.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. DEKHI GAYI NA SHADI AISI KOI JAHA'N MEIN.
HAR EK BARATI JISKA MASROOF HAI FUGH'AN MEIN.
CHAAYA SOHAIL AISA GHAM ARZ AUR SAMA MEIN.
AANSOO BAHAKE APNE PADHTE HAI SAB YEH NAUHA.
AZ: JANAB RAZA ALI ""SOHAIL"" SAHAB.

items.title: aye jaane dile hydere karrar alamdar
items.body:
Ae jane dile hydere karrar Alamdar Alamdar, Ae quwaate sibte shahe abrar Alamdar Alamdar.
Ta hashr teri yaad zamane me rahegi, Ae sarware alam ke wafadar Alamdar Alamdar.
Marne se tere lashkare sheh hogaya barbad, Ae mere musibat ke madadgar Alamdar Alamdar.
Dikhlado fir ek bar mujhe chand si surat, Marta hai tera talibe deedar Alamdar Alamdar.
Darya se utho bhai ki imdad ko aao, Tanha hai ye ab bekaso nachat Alamdar Alamdar.
Jab tak safe matam meri duniya me bichegi, Royege tujhe mere azadar Alamdar Alamdar.

items.title: Koofe me dard o gham ki ajab chagayi faza
items.body:
KOOFE MEIN DARD-O-GHAM KI AJAB CHHAGAYI FAZA, DOOBA HUA HAIN KHOON MEIN SAB FARQE MURTAZA
KOOFE KE BEKASO THA DAR PAR EK ISDEHAAM, BAITUL SHARAF THA BANGAYA MATAM SARA TAMAM, SAB KO DILASA DETE THE SAR THAM KAR IMAM, SAIDANIYO KE LAB PA THA BAS WA MUSIBATA
PEHLU BADAL BADAL KE TADAPTE THE MURTUZA, GEHRA HAI ZAKHM AB NA GIZA HAI NA HAI DAWA, BABA KO DEKH DEKH KE ROTE HAIN MUJTABA, SAR PEET KAR LAHAD MEIN TADAPTI HAIN FATIMA
HASNAIN ROKE KEHTE THE BABA NA JAIYYE, HUM GHAM ZADOON KO ITNA NA BABA RULAIYE, JATE HO KIS PA CHOOD KE BABA BATAIYE, KIS TARHA HOGA HUMSE YATEEMI KA SAMNA
PHIR DIL KAR HUSSAIN KE RUQ PAR NAZAR IMAM, BOLE TU ZIBHA HOYEGA KARBAL MEIN TASHNA KAAM, ASHOOR KO LOOTE GA TERA GHAR GHAR TAMAM, NAMOOS KE SARO SE BHI CHEEN JAYEGI RIDA
BHUKO KA BEKASO KA SAHARA NAHI RAHA, PEETO SAR APNE MOULA HAMARA NAHI RAHA, AB TO SOHAIL ZABT KA YAARA NAHI RAHA, UTHTA HAIN AB JANAZA WASIYE RASOOL KA..

items.title: Tukde hogaya dulha ran se laash aayi hai
items.body:
TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI
KARBALA MEIN HAI DEKHO EHTEMAAM SHAADI KA, KUCH AJAB NIRALA HAI INTEZAAM SHAADI KA, MAUT KE DAHANE PAR HAI MAQAAM SHAADI KA, KHOON MEIN BHARI CHADAR KHAAK PAR BICHAYEE HAI, TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI
HAYE QASIM-E-NAUSHAH RAN MEIN BESIPAR AAYE, FAUJ-E-SHAAM SE LADNE LEKE DIL JIGAR AAYE, TAN PE TEER BHI AYE SAR PE BHI TABAR AAYE, KHURB-E-SAHILE DARIYA KHOON KI TARAYI HAI, TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI
KHUSK NELE HOTON PAR SISKIYAN MACHALTI HAIN, HICHKIYAN BHI SEENE MEIN KARWATEN BADALTI HAIN, KHAAK UDATI KHAIMON SE BIBIYAN NIKALTI HAIN, BADNASEEB KUBRA KO YE QHABAR SUNAYI HAIN, TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI
BADNASEEB KUBRA KI HAYE MAANG KYA UJDI, KARBALA MEIN DUNIYA HI LUT KE REHGAYI SAARI, BEKASI KE AALAM MEIN SAANS BHI CHALI RUKHTI, EK QHAYAMAT E KUBRA KARBALA PE CHAHYI HAIN, TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI
GULBADAN KE HAATON MEIN HAYE KYA LAGI MEHENDI, RANG-E-GUL NIKHARTE HI TAYGH KI GIRI BIJLI, KHAAK MEIN MILA SEHRA KHATM HOGAYI SHAADI, KARBALA MEIN BUS TARMEEM YE KHABAR SUNAYI HAIN, TUKDE HOGAYA DULHA RAN SE LAASH AYEE HAI

items.title: Kyun Chor Jaati Hai Maa
items.body:
Gir Chuka Dar Fatima Par
Ab Hai Zakhmi Muhammad Ki Beti
Haye Ik Din Sar Jhukaye
Apne Hujray Mein Bethi Hoi Thi Phir Hussain Aa Ke Amma Se Kehne Lagay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankh Mein Kyun Hain Aanso Batao Mujhe
Fatima Ne Kaha Mere NooreNazar
Aaj Amma Ki Yaad Aa Rahi Hai Mujhe
Sun Ke Maa Ki Sada Dil Tarapney Laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Ke Shabeer Ne Fatima Se Kaha Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Ungli Pakar Ke Chalaya Seene Se Tum Ne Lagaya
Inn Teen Saloon Mein Amma Tum Ne Bohat Kuch Sikhaya
Maa Se Bichar Ke Jeetay Hain Kaisay Kya Yeh Sikhati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Darwaza Jab Se Gira Hai Pehlu Shikasta Howa Hai
Totein Hoi Pasliyaan Hain Shabeer Sab Janta Hai
Takleef Mein Hoon Bachoon Ko Apne Kab Yeh Batati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Iss Fikar Mein Jaag Jana Pyasa Na Ho Mera Beta
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahsas Hai Mujh Ko Amma Kya Pyar Hota Hai Maa Ka
Raton Ko Uth Kar Betay Ko Apne Pani Pilati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Qissa Mujhe Aik Maa Ka Bhaiyya Hasan Ne Sunaya
Beta Wahin Samne Tha Jab Maa Ne Khaya Tamacha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Apne Ghar Mein Beton Se Apna Chehra Chupati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Jab Se Laga Taziyana Mushkil Tha Mujh Ko Sulana
Jab Hath Dekha Tumhara Tab Ja Ke Main Ne Yeh Jana
Hoon Hath Zakhmi Phir Bhi Thapak Kar Lori Sunati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabeer Ne Phir Sada Di Kya Chor Jao Gi Tum Bhi
Kyun Aisa Kehti Ho Amma Rehti Nahi Maa Kissi Ki
Acha Batao Kya Door Ja Ke Phir Laut Aati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Maa Ne Kaha Phir Yeh Shabeer Se Har Maa Tu Aati Nahi Laut Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Mere Dil Mere NooreNazar Zahra Ka Ab Tum Se Wadah Hai Yeh
Jab Tum Bulao Gay Aaye Gi Maa Seene Se Tum Ko Lagaye Gi Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Ik Roz Aisa Bhi Aaya Tha Fatima Ka Janaza
Rukh Se Kafan Jab Hataya Shabeer Ne Maa Se Pocha
<<DIVIDER>>
ZaireKafan Bhi Aawaz Sun Kar Aanso Bahati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Bin Maa Ke Bachoon Se Aa Ke Jab Haal Pocha Ali Ne
Haye Raza Our Zeeshan Shabeer Ro Ro Ke Bolay
Aye Baba Ghar Mein Lagta Nahi Dil Jab Yaad Aati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa

items.title: Laaye Hussain ran se Qasim bane ka lasha

items.title: Kalaam : Meer Kumail Ali
items.body:
Aye Shabbar(a.s) ki Jaan Aye Farwa(s.a) ke chaand Noushahe Karbala
Mai Tere khurbaan Aye Ammu ki shaan Noushahe Karbala
1. Tum jo karte ho talab mujhse izne wegha
mai kaise du'n tumko izn mere beta
tum ho nishaani, mere bhai ki Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Phir laaya Qasim(a.s) ne Taweez baba ki
usme ye likhi thi tahreer baba ki
meri taraf se, hoga fidya Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Padhte hi khat to Shabbir roye
Bole Qasim ko gale se lagaake
hai izn tumko, jao maidaa'n ko Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ibne Hassan(a.s) jo chla madar ko chordh kar
Kubra(s.a) ye kehti thi Qasim(a.s) se ro ro kar
Jaate ho kyunkar, mujhko chordkar Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Maidaa'n me Jaakar shabbar(a.s) ke bete ne
Azraq ko maarkar shabbar(a.s) ke bete ne
Kaha ke chacha, pyaasa hai bada Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ladta kaha'n tak bhala Noushahe Karbala
Pyaasa kayi din ka tha Noushahe Karbala
lagte hi khanjar, aaya zamee'n par Noushahe Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Girne lage jab Qasim(a.s) dekha chacha ko
Salaame Aakhir kiya apna chacha ko
Haider(a.s) ka jamaal, hogaya Pamaal Noushahe Karbala
Kalaam : Meer Kumail Ali

talwar ran me dulhe ka mu qoo'n se dhoti hai
qaime me ghul hai aaj dulhan beva hoti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
beh beh ke qoo'n tapakta hai har baar haath se
zaqmi hai nikli jaati hai talwaar haath se
ab kya kare nabard hai paikaar haath se
chooti enaan-e aspe wafaadar haath se
<<MINI>>
qoo'n bahgaya jahaa'n se mu modhne lage
gir kar zameen-e- garm pa dam todhne lage
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kaatne udhar se badhe fouj ke sawaar
doudhe idhar se shaah alam karke zulfeqaar
the saath saath akbar-o- abbas-e- naamdaar
dehshat se teen shero'n ki bhaage sitam sheyaar
<<MINI>>
majrooh natawaa'n ka ajab haal hogaya
ghodo'n se jism dulha ka paamal hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
rone lage imaam-e- umam dekh kar ye haal
laasha uthaa ke le chale aaqir basad malaal
ek do qadam badha tha rasool-e- quda ka laal
hichki jo aayi margaya hai hai wo qushqisaal
<<MINI>>
godi me sheh ki phool se kumlaa ke rahgaye
baazu lahu bhare huwe tharra ke rahgaye
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ne dekha sheh ko jo aate huwe idhar
qaime ke sahan se ye pukari ba-chashme tar
saidanio'n uroos se hushiyaar-o- ba qabar
deodhi tak aayi maadar-e- noushaah nouhagar
<<MINI>>
faaqo'n se hai nidhaal qadam ladkhadaate hai
masnad bichaao dulha ko shabbir laate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haalat hai gham se ghair shah-e- qushqisaal ki
hai hai jawaani qasim-e- yousuf jamaal ki
poshaak qoo'n se surq hai is nou nehaal ki
aao baraat dekhlo shabbar ke laal ki
<<MINI>>
rone ka shor charq pa jaata hai saahibo
dulha chacha ki god me aata hai saahibo
<<DIVIDER>>
doudhe haram idhar se khule sar barahna paa
qaime me aaye laash liye shaah-e- dosaraa
naamoos me qiyaamate kubra huwi bapaa
waa qaasima ki charq pa jaane lagi sadaa
<<MINI>>
bahne'n qareeb aagayi aansu bahane ko
phailaaye maa ne haath gale se lagaane ko
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime tak aaye sab haram-e- paak nouha gar
laasha litake rone lage shaah-e- behrobar
abbas peetne lage haatho'n se apna sar
akbar ka paas rakh diya sehra lahu me tar
<<MINI>>
taazeer haal maadar-e- ghamnaak hogaya
seene ke zaqm dekh ke dil chaak hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ne baandha hujre ka parda basad malaal
laaye dulhan ko thaam ke bano-e- qushqisaal
mitti bhari thi maang me kubra ka tha ye haal
mai-li si chaadar odhe huwe khole sar ke baal
<<MINI>>
dikhla ke zaqm sab jasad-e- paash paash ke
bithla diya uroos ko pahlu me laash ke
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dam dulhan ne dulha ke zaqmo'n pa ki nazar
kaampa kaleja ashk bahe shaq huwa jigar
qadmo'n ki simt jhuk ke ye boli wo nouhagar
saaheb utho ham aaye hai laashe pa nange sar
<<MINI>>
khole hai baal bekas-o- naalaa'n ko dekhlo
tum bhi hamare haal-e- pareshaa'n ko dekhlo
<<DIVIDER>>
saaheb bataao kya mai aseer-e- mehan kahoo'n
bekas kahoo'n, ghareeb kahoo'n, bewatan kahoo'n, majroo kahoo'n mai aap ko ya bekafan kahoo'n
dulha kahoo'n ke aapko ibn-e- hassan kahoo'n
kya kehke ro-u koi batataa nahi'n mujhe
tazaa dulhan hoo'n bain bhi aata nahi mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ne laake itne me randsaala rakhdiya
dulha ki maa ne haath me usko uthaa liya aur boli isko pahno ye qillat hai beva ka
kubra ne sar ko peet ke aur roke ye kaha
ab kyu'n libaas bevon ka mujh ko pinhaate hai
dulhan banake kya koi bevaa banaate hai

items.body:
Margaye Saqqaye haram haye haye, Sheh ki kamar hogayi qam haye haye.
Neher pe Abbas ke shane kate, Lut gaye Sultane umam haye haye.
Gham se kamar toot gayi Shah ki, Uth nahi sakte hain qadam haye haye.
Sar bhi Alamdar ka shaq hogaya, Hogaye bazu bhi qalam haye haye.
Mit gaya ab fouje Khuda ka nishan, Khoon mein duba hai alam haye haye.
Kehte the Sheh bhai ke shaida utho, Ghere hain sab ahle sitam haye haye.

items.title: Thi sada ye zainab ki aye hussain ke bhai
items.body:
THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, DEKHO MERI TANHAI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
KARBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN MUJHSE CHUT GAYA AKBAR, BHAI PAR FIDA HOKAR CHAL BASE MERE DILBAR, TUM BHI ROOTH KAR MUJHSE SOGAYE HODARIYA PAR, KAISI TUMKO NEEND AAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
MERI MANNATOU WALA WO MERA ALI AKBAR, CHAL BASA HAI DUNIYA SE SEENE PAR SINA KHAKAR, NOUJAWAAN KE LAASHE PAR POUNCHE JIS GHADI SARWAR, JA CHUKI THI BINAEE AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
BAD-E- ASR-E-ASHOORA HAR QADAM PA AAFAT THI, SHUMR KE TAMACHE THE BEKASI THI GHURBAT THI, PHIR YATEEMO KE SAR PAR EK NAYI MUSIBAT THI, ZULM KI GHATA CHHAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
<<DIVIDER>>
BHAI TERE MARNE SE WO JAFA HUI HUM PAR, KARBALA SE KUFA TAK HUM PHIRE BA REHNA SAR, BHAI TERI ZAINAB KE FARQ PAR NA THI CHADAR, KHALQ THI TAMASHAYI AYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
AB BHI HAI NIGHAO MEIN WO LAHOO BHARA MANZAR, THA GIRA LAEENAO MEIN IBNE FATEHE QAIBAR, TEEN DIN KE PYAASE KE HALQ PAR CHALA KHANJAR, KYON NA MUJHKO MOUT AAYI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
HO KAHA MERE BHAIYYA LO QABAR ZARA UTH KAR, SHUMR NE SAKINA KE CHEENE KANOU SE GAUHAR, QAID HOKE JATI HAI DAR BA DAR TERI QWAHER, KYA KARE YE MAA JAYI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI
KAR QUBOOL YE NOUHA IBNE SAQIYA KAUSAR, MOOSAVI KO BULWALE JALD APNE ROUZE PAR, AUR PADHE YE PARWANE TERE ROUZE PAR AAKAR, AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI, THI SADA YE ZAINAB KI AAYE HUSSAIN KE BHAI..

kehti thi maa mai kis tarha jee paungi bhala
beemar ek behen tera takti hai raasta

kya de'n jawaab usko teri maa zara bata

nouha ye padhke pursa tumhe denge hum sada
kaise sohail ab ho baya'n dard o gham bhala

bete ka koi dard na bhoole shahe huda

items.title: DASHTE GURBAT MAY NA YUNN CHHOD KE JAO ABBAS
items.body:
DASHTE GURBAT MAY NA YUNN CHHOD KE JAO ABBAS
ROOKAY KEHTEY THHAY YE SARWAR NA RULAO ABBAS
1. KISTARHA DOON TUJHE MARNE KI IJAZAT BHAI
TERE HI DAM SE HAI SHABBIR KO QUWWAT BHAI PHIR KAHAN PAAOUNGA MAI TERI MOHABBAT BHAI
APNE BHAI KO ZARA TUM HI BATAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
2. KYUN KAMAR BAANDHE HO AADA PA CHADHAYII KE LIYE
HAAN MAGAR TUMKO NA JAANA HAI LADAYII KE LIYE
BAAZU KATWANA HAI UMMAT KI BHALAYII KE LIYE
MERI BATAON SE MAGAR DIL NA DUKHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
3. YEH NA SOONCHA KE TERE BAAD MERA KYA HOGA AUR KUCH DAIR MAY AKBAR BHI RAWANA HOGA
KOUN SHABBIR KI PEERI KA SAHARA HOGA
KAISE DU’N TUMKO RIZA ITNA BATAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
4. MERE BHAI MERE LASHKAR KE ALAMDAR HO TUM
HAQ ME ZAINAB KE LIYE HYDER E KARRAR HO TUM AUR BEKAS KE GHARIBON KE MADADGAAR HO TUM
KYA MAI ZAINAB KO BATAON YE BATAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
5. TERE MARNE SE KUNBA PARESHA’N HOGA
BEKASI HOYEGI OR DASHTE GHARIBAA’N HOGA
KOUN PHIR CHADAR E ZAINAB KA NIGEHBAA’N HOGA
APNI BEHNOU’N PE ZARA RAHEM TOU KHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
6. BHAI KO ROOTAY HUWAY CHHOD KE KYA JAAOGEY
WASWASEY AATAY HAIN TUM LOUT KE NA AAOGEY
MERI MINNAT PA BHI KYA RAHEM NAHI KHAOGEY
KAISE MAIN TUMKO MANAO’N YE BATAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
7. MOOSVI KAHTE THAY GHAZI SE SHAIHEY KOUN O MAKAAN
SAAT BATTEES BARAS HII KA THA AYE RAHATE JAAN T
UM BICHAD JAO TOU PHIR ZEEST KA IMKAAN KAHAN
MERI GURBAT PA TARAS KHAO NA JAO ABBAS
AZZ: MUSTAFA MOOSVI.

Qaime mein qayamat thi barpa, pamaal huwa jis dum laasha

Manzar tha qayamat ka wo Nazar, phat-ta tha har ek ka gham se jigar

items.title: Abbas hamara hai
items.body:
Abbas hamara hai
(Abbas-e-Ali Aaye Karib-e-Shah-e-Abrrar) x2
Bhayi ko Alam deke kiya sheh ne bohot pyar
Has has ke rafiko se ye karne lage guftaar, jaisi ye meri fowj hai waisaa hi Alamdar
Gazi sa koyi deen ka sardar na hoga, Abbas sa dunya mai(n) alamdar na hoga
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2 Hashim ka kamar haider-e-Karrar pyara
<<MINI>>
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
Haider ke garane ki sakhawat sakhi abbas, khoone abu talib ki sadakat sakhi abbas, zehra ki duwao ki taharat sakhi abbas, kudrat ne banaya nahi phir aisaa dubaraa.
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Qur'an-e-wafa sheyr-e-nayafshaan-e-ali hai, Zehra ki tamanna hai dil-o-jaan-e-ali hai, is ke liye bachpan hi se farmaan-e-ali hai, mei ilm ka darya hu ye darya ka kanara
<<MINI>>
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Paida huwe abbas to gaudi me utha ker, Zainab ne rakha naam kaleje se lagaa ker, chotaa sa alam sheh ne diya unko sajaa ker, dekha jo alam ne to alam khud ye pukara
<<MINI>>
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
Ye panjetan-e-pak ke lashker ka nisha(n) hai, Kehte hai ye Shabbir meraa shere jawaa(n) hai, Aisa koyi dunya me alamdar kaha hai, Shehwan se hai sheh baaz kalandar ka ye naaraa
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas-e-Ali ruh-e-wafaa jaan-e-wafa hai, Abbas-e-Ali fatema Zehra ki duwaa hai, har waqt alam chumti rehti ye hawaa hai, bhulaa nahi abbas ko darya ka kanaraa
<<MINI>>
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dunya-e Shahadat me kaha(n) uskaa hai sani, jo saare shahido ki safo me raha ghazi, be dast bhi ho ker jo bhare joliyaa(n) sabki, hashim ka kamar sare fakiro ka sahara
<<MINI>>
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
Haider ke garane ki sakhawat sakhi abbas, khoone abu talib ki sadakat sakhi abbas, zehra ki duwao ki taharat sakhi abbas, kudrat ne banaya nahi phir aisaa dubaraa.
Sakhi (Abbas hamara hai(n) alamdar hamara) x2
Ye panjetan-e-pak ke lashker ka nisha(n) hai, Kehte hai ye Shabbir meraa shere jawaa(n) hai, Aisa koyi dunya me alamdar kaha hai, Shehwan se hai sheh baaz kalandar ka ye naaraa

<<DIVIDER>>
Lazim hai ke ham dekhe(n)ge ik roza ye manzar, farmayenge jab mehdiyo dora dar-e-mimbar, kabe se namudaar jo hoga mera lashkar, hoga yahi lashkar ka alamdar hamaraa.

Yad ata hai wo rukhsate-e-abbas ka manzar, wo rona sakina ka phareyra ko pakar kar, Wo dekhna Zainab ka kabhi sar kabhi chadar, kehti thi palat aye behen bhayi ka pyara

items.title: Zainab se kaha sheh ne alam qaime me lakar mai hogaya tanha
items.body:
ZAINAB SE KAHA SHEH NE ALAM KHAIME MEIN LAKAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
MARAGAYE DARYA PA ALAMDAR BARADAR MAIN HOGAYA TAHNA
DARYA PA KAATE MERE ALAMDAR KE SHAANE JAB AHLE JAFA NE, HAMLA KIYA PICCHE SE MERE BHAI PA CHUP KAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
GHERE HUE HAIN CHARO TARAF SE SITAM EJAAD TAYYAR HAIN JALLAD, GARDANPA CHALEGA MERI AB SHUMR KA KHANJAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR KAAT KE NAIZE PA CHADHEYENGE AB ADA YE ZULM BHI HOGA, AB KOUN BACHAYEGA MUJHE AAYE MERI QAHAR MAIN HOGAYA TAHNA
AKBAR HAI QASIM HAI NA HAI OUN MOHAMMED HAI ZULM KI YE HADD, SAAB LUT GAYA KARBAL MEIN MERA HAYE BHARA GHAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
DIL ZAKHMI NAZAR ZAKHMI KAMAR TUTI HUI HAI AFAAT KI GHADI HAI, ROTA HOON BHAI KOTOHHASTEY HAIN SITAMGAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
AB KOI BHI JINE KI MUJHE AAS NAHIN HAI ABBAS NAHIN HAI, BIN BHAI KE IS DASHT MEIN ZINDA RAHOO KYON KAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAIMO KO JALAYENGE SARE SHAAM YE AZLAM IS BAAT KA HAI GHAM, CHEEN JAYEGI ZAINAB TERE SAR SE TERI CHADAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA
YE NOUHA HAMEED AUR HASAN KA JO NAYA HAI AWAAZE AZAA HAI, HAIN BAIN MERE HAAL PA DONO KI ZUBAAN PAR MAIN HOGAYA TANHA..

items.body:

yeh Phool Zaqmou'n Ke Tan Pe Sajaye Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>

laraz Raha Hai Badan Pau'n Thar Tharate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khade Hain Khaime Ke Dar Par Jo Aake Ahl-e-har
baraat Dekh Ke Dulha Ki Rote Jaate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Macha Hai Khaimou'n Me Kohraam Haaye Qasim Ka
hussain Laash Se Chadar Ko Ab Hatate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Le Aayi Laash Pe Baazu Ko Thaam Kar Madar
dulhan Ko Dulha Ka Deedaar Ab Karate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Sajaye The Abhi Sandal Se Maang Haaye Ghazab
usi Ko Bewa Ka Ab Pairahan Pinhate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Saroun Pe Khaak Udhao Mujaab Peeto Sar
yeh Aisa Gham Hai Ke Is Gham Me Khoo'n Bahate Hain

items.body:
Mehsoos kare koi to, dil kaap uthega

Pardes....
<<DIVIDER>>

Pardes....
<<DIVIDER>>

Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>

ek baad e shahadat bhi hai, (maidaan ka ghaazi)..(2)

<<MINI>>
Pardes...
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>

items.title: Hai Raahnuma himmate mardanae qasim
items.body:
HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM (A.S)
BHOOLEGI NA DUNIYA KABHI AFSANAY E QASIM, TAREEQ KE SAFHE HAIN YEH BEGANAYE QASIM, HAR SAHEB-E-KIRDAAR HAI DEEWANYE QASIM, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
IS UMR MEIN WOH JUNG KA ANDAAZ NIRALA , BIJLI NE KIYA SHAAM KI FAUJAON MEIN UJALA, THA JALWAYE SHAMSHEER SE LASHKAR TAHO BALA, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
THI JISKI KI KALAYI MEIN YADULLAH KI QUWWAT, DADA SSE MILI THI JISE VIRSE MEIN SHUJAYATH, TA HASHR JO HAI MAUJIZAYE JURRATH O HIMMAT, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
<<DIVIDER>>
BACHPAN MEIN JO RAKHTA HAI BUZURGAON KA IRADA, JO AZAM -E-HASAN KA THA NAMUNA WOH KHUZADA , HAI MARKAZ-E- HAQ JISKA BANYA HUVA JADA, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
QASIM KI NIGAHAON MEIN WHO SHABBIR KA MAQSAD, PABAND-E-RIZA RAZIYE TAQDEER KA MAQSAD, JAAN DENE MEIN THA KHAOM KI TAMEER KA MAQSAD, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
KYA JANIYE THI MADAR-E-MUZTAR KI TAMANNA , BABA KI WASIYATH THI GAZAMFAR KI TAMANNA, PURI HUVI AAKHIR DILEY SHABBAR KI TAMANNA, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM
MAQBOOL NA HO KISLLIYE NAUHA TERA SAJID , KYON KAR NA TADAP JAYE HAREK AARIF-O-ABID, MAMDOOh TERA NUSRATH-E-EMAAN MEIN HAI WAHID, HAI RAHNUMA HIMMAT-E-MARDANAYE QASIM JANBAAZ-E-FIDAKAAR HAI PARWANAYE QASIM..

items.body:

Jo Be Kafan Hai Oss Ka Darbar Saj Raha Hai.
Woh Ho Raha Hai Jo Bhi Abbas Ne Kaha Hai.
Hain Surkh Roshni Mein Kalay Libas Walay.

Ro Ro Ke Keh Rahe Hain Afsoos Hai Yeh Bibi.
Aye Kash Hum Jo Hotey Ashor Walay Din Bhi.
Nu Lakh Zalimo Mein Tanha Na Hotey Maula.
Labaik Keh Rahe Hain Our Rotay Ja Rahe Hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Norani Chehray Walay Galon Pe Khak Mal Kar.
Zawwar Aa Rahe Hain Paidal Najaf Se Chal Kar.
Iss Ishq Ke Safar Mein Har Shaks Maizbaan Hai.
Kuch Loag Rastay Se Pathar Hata Rahe Hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Unn Par Salam Ho Jo Besakhiyon Pe Aaye.
Paon Ke Bal Nahi They Phir Bhi Na Larkharaye.
Milti Nahi Sabhi Ko Yeh Ishq Ki Bulandi.
Bas Ya Hussain Keh Kar Woh Chalte Ja Rahe Hain.

Thamay Hoye Tabaruk Rahoon Mein Jo Kharey Hain.
Qasim Ka Naam Le Kar Taqseem Kar Rahe Hain.
Dono Jahan Mein Aisa Jazba Kahin Na Dekha.
Jo Saal Bhar Kamaya Woh Sab Luta Rahe Hain.

Yeh Woh Zameen Hai Jis Par Pyasi Rahein Sakina.
Ghazi Ko Yaad Kar Ke Roti Rahein Sakina.
Ab Iss Zameen Pe Koi Pyasa Nahi Hai Dekho.
Pyason Ko Mashk Walay Pani Pila Rahe Hain.

ZEESHAN aur RAZA Jab Maula Ke Pas Jana.
Hur Ki Qasam Hai Tum Ko Tabdeel Ho Ke Aana.

items.title: Abbas dekho lasha e qasim ko ek nazar
items.body:
MAQTAL MEIN KHO NA JAYE KAHEEN LAASHE BEPIDAR
ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-QASIM KO EK NAZAR
TAYGHON KI ZAD MEIN AAGAYA FARWA KA PISAR, SEENE SE SHAHE DEEN KE NIKALTA HAI AB JIGAR, WO GULBADAN KE SEHRE KI LADIYAN HAI KHOON ME TAR, HAI JISM PARA PARA LAHO MEIN BHARA HAI SAR, ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-QASIM KO EK NAZAR
PAUNCHE JO DONO LASHA-E-QASIM PE NOUHAGAR, BIKHRE HUE THE TUKDE ZAMEEN PAR IDHAR UDHAR, NAZROU MEIN PHIR RAHA THA WAHIN BHAI KA JIGAR, APNI ABA BICHAHYE HAIN SHABBIR KHAAK PAR, ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-QASIM KO EK NAZAR
<<DIVIDER>>
PAMAAL HO KE HAYE GHAREEBUL WATAN GAYE, MAQTAL SE TABA KHAIMA JO IBNE HASSAN GAYE, ZAKHMON KE HAAR LE KE WO SHIREEN SUQAN GAYE, DIL GHAM SE DOOBTA HAI KAHAN GULBADAN GAYE, ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-EQASIM KO EK NAZAR
FIZZA BHI DIL JALI RAHI KHAIME MEIN NOUHAGAR, FARWA NE SAR JHUKADIYA BETE KI LAASH PAR, ZAINAB NE AAH SARD BHARI LAASH DEKHKAR, KYA TUM KO MAIN BATAON KE PHAT TA HAI AB JIGAR, ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-QASIM KO EK NAZAR
KUBRA BHI RAH NA PAYEGI DUNIYA MEIN CHAIN SE, KARBO BALA DAHELTI HAI ZEHRA KE BAIN SE, HUSHIYAAR MERE LAAL SHAHE MASHREQAIN SE, MAYYAT UTHEGI KAISE BHALA AB HUSSAIN SE, ABBAS DEKHO LAASHA-E-QASIM KO EK NAZAR

items.title: Betiyon Kay Pass Lejao Mujhe
items.body:

Sar Shikasta Ho Gaya Uth Na Sakay Maula Ali.

Dekh Kar Beton Ka Chehra Yeh Ali Kehne Lagay. Waqt Kam Hai Betiyon Ke Pas Le Jao Mujhe.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Kar Zainab Ko Meri Sans Mein Sans Aaye Gi. Dekh Kar Kulsoom Ko Yeh Zindagi Barh Jaye Gi.
Baap Kuch Din Our Jee Le Betiyon Ke Samne.
Zakhm Zarbat Ka Wahan Yeh Dekhna Zahir Na Ho. Khon Sar Se Saaf Kar Ke Phir Amama Bandh Do. Betiyaan Ghabra Na Jaein Meri Halat Dekh Ke.

Woh Agar Mangay Tu De Dena Nishani Baap Ki.
Yeh Musalla Sath Rakh Lo Meri Zainab Ke Liye.

Betiyaan Hain Baap Ki Maiyyat Pe Ronaq Ka Sabab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khush Naseebi Hai Khuda Beti Atta Kar De Jisay.
Apne Baba Ke Janazay Par Jo Roein Fatima.
Oss Ghari Main Apni Zainab Ke Liye Rota Raha.

items.title: Yaade Abbas me zainab ne pukaara Abbas
items.body:
YAADE ABBAS MEIN ZAINAB NE PUKAARA ABBAS
DASHT MEIN CHHOD GAYE KYON MUJHE TANHA ABBAS
QHALB ZAKHMI HAI MERA KAISE SANBHALOON QUD KO, MERI AANKHAON MEIN HAI AKBAR KA KALEJA ABBAS
TERE MARNE NE KAMAR TOODI MERA BHAYI KI, DEGA MAAJAYE KO AB KOUN SAHARA ABAAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SUNTI HU HAATH KATE SAR PA LAGA GURZ TERE, KAISE TUHJ PAR YE SITAM HOGAYE BHAIYYA ABBAS
AB NA QASIM HAI NA AKBER HAI NA BHAYI SHABBIR, BEKASAON KA NAHI AB KOI SAHARA ABBAS
TERE DAM SE THI HAR EK BIBI KE DIL KO DHARAS, AB HAR EK LAB PA HAI BAS TERA HI NOUHA ABBAS
AAG KHAIMAON MEIN LAGI BISTARE BIMAAR JALA, JALGAYA ASGHAR-E-BESHEER KA JHOOLA ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
KAAN BHI ZAKHMI HAIN RUQHSAAR BHI ZAKHMI USKE, KAISE DOON TERI SAKINA KO DILASA ABBAS
KAMSINI MEIN HAIN SAKINA PE MAZALIM PAIHAM, USKA AB KOI NAHIN POOCHNE WALA ABBAS
SAR PA CHADAR NAHIN BAZOO MEIN RASAN HAI MERE, DEKHTE KYON NAHIN AAKAR MERE BHAIYYA ABBAS
MUSHKILEN DUR HUI MUJHSE USI LAMHA RASHEED, MAINE JAB TOOTE HUE DIL SE PUKARA ABBAS..

items.title: Abbas kaha ho meri imdad ko aao
items.body:
ABBAS KAHA HO MERI IMDAAD KO AAO
MAAJAYE KA SAR KAT TAY HI IS DASHT-E-BALA MAIN, AAYE HAIN SITAMGAR YAHAAN KHAIMO KO JALANE, BABA BHI NAHI AAYE HAIN ZAINAB KO BACCHANE, IS BAN MAIN LOOT TI HOON MADAD KARNE AOO
WO RAAT KA SANNATA WO BACCHON KA BILAKH NA, AUR KHOUF SE ZA LIM KE WO BEWOA KA LARAZNA, DEKHA NAHIN JATA HAI SAKINA KA TADAPNA, KURTE MAIN LAGI AAG HAI TUM AAKE BACCHAO
MASOOM KO DURRE JO LAGATA HAIN SITAMGAR, KHAMOOSH KHADE ROTE HAIN BAS ABID-E-BIMAR, KAANO SE LAHOO BEHTA HAIN AUR SOOJHE HAIN RUQSAR, AB AAKE BHATIJEE KO KALEJE SE LAGAYO
<<DIVIDER>>
ZEHRA KI BAHOO BETIYON KE HAATH BADHEIN HAI, BE MAQNA-O-CHADAR SAR-E-BAZAAR PHIRE HAI, DARBAR MAIN ZALIM KE BHI SAR NANGE KHADE HAI, HOTA HA I TAROOF MERA TUM AAKE RUKAOO
JAB BEESWI RAMZAN KO YE BABA NE KAHA THA, ZAINAB TERE BAAZO MAIN RASAN BANDHEIN GE AADA, PAR DIL KO YAKEEN THA MERE ABBBAS HAIN ZINDA, AB CHEENTI HAI CHADAR MERI TUM AAKE DILAOO
ZANJEER MAIN JAKHDA HAIN MERA ABID-E-DILGIR, CHALNE MAIN USSE HOTI HAIN EK LAMHA JO TAQEER, NAIZE SE AZIYAT USSE POUNCHA TE HAIN BE PEER, BIMAR KO TUM AAKE LAIEEN NO CHOODAOO
NOUHA YE LIKHA MOOSAVI NE BA DIL-E-PURNAM, HASRAT HAI KAROON ROUZA PA PHIR MAJLIS-O-MATAM, AUR SAATH HAIN PARWANE SADA DETE HAIN PAIHAM, BHAIYYA YE AZADARO KO ROUZE PA BULAOO..

items.body:

Hathon se kamar ko thame huwe – Ankhon se lahu barsate huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ye jab paye ye khaber – Be dast huwa Ibne Hyder
Bachon se Sakina kehti thi – Lane hai gaye ammu pani

Khaime mein Shahe deen Zainab se – Ro ro ke yehi farmate the
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhin jayegi ab teri chadar – Be dast huwa Ibne Hyder
Maqtal mein ye kehte the aada – Shabbir ka jab kateinge gala
Hoga na koi usdam Yawar – Be dast huwa Ibne Hyder

items.title: Ye kiski hogayi pamaal laash maqtal me
items.body:
YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
ABHI TOH DULHA BANAYAGAYA THA IBNE HASAN, BANI THI FATIMA KUBRA ABHI ABHI DULHAN, UTHA YEH SHOR KE ADA MEIN AAYA TASHNA DAHAN, GIRA JO GHODE SE PAMAAL HOGAYA HAI BADAN, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
SADA YE DETE THE AKBAR KE AAIYE BABA, GHIRA HAIN LAKHO MEIN QASIM HASAN KA MAHE LAQA, HAR EK SIMT SE HOTA HAI PYAASE PAR HAMLA, PUKARTA HAIN MADAD KO MERI TUM AOO CHACHA, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
HUSSAIN THAM KE DIL KO CHALE HAIN LAASHE PAR, HAIN SAAT GAIZ MEIN ABBAS AUR ALI AKBAR, JO POUNCHE LAASHE PA SARWAR TOH THA AJAB MANZAR, BIKHAR KE LAASHA PADHA THA ZAMIN-E- KARBAL PAR, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
JO DEKHI BHAI KI TASWEER KHOON MEIN GALTA, TAMAM JISM PA GHODO KI TAPOU KE THE NISHAA, TADAP KE KEHTE THE QASIM CHACHA TERE KHURBAA, MAI AASAKA NA MADAD KO NIKAL GAYI TERI JAAN, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
THI MUNTAZAR DARE KHAIMA PE ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR, UTHA KE LAYE HAIN LAASHA HUSSAIN KANDHE PAR, POUHANCH KE KHAIME PA KEHTE THE SHAHE JINNO BASHAR, HUA HAI TEEROU SE ZAKHMI HASAN KA LAQTE JIGAR, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
JO DEKHA BETE KA LAASHA TADAP GAYI MAADAR, LIPAT KE KEHTI THI KHURBAAN MAA TERE DILBAR, BALAYE LETI THI LAASHE KE GIRD PHIR PHIR KAR, PACHADE KHATI THI DULHAN TOH HOTA THA MEHSHAR, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
YE BAIN KARTI THI LAASHE PA GHAM ZADA DULHAN, KISE DIKHAON MEIN HAAL APNA DIL KA IBNE HASAN, UTAR NA PAYA MERE HAAT SE ABHI KANGAN, MEIN BEWA HOGAYI MERAUJAD GAYA JEEWAN, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
DULHAN KE BAIN SE KHAIME MEIN HOTA THA KOHRAAM, JO SAR KO PEET KE KARTI THI AAHO ZARI TAMAM, UTHO HUM AAYE HAIN LAASHE PA LO HAMARA SALAAM, DILASA DETE THE BETI KO SHAHE ARSHE MUQAAM, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN
AYE MOSSAVI YEHI ROROKE KEHTI THI DUKHIYA, BATAO KIS KE SAHARE MUJHE YAHAN CHOODA, NA SAR SE SEHRA UTAR PAYA HOGAYI BEWA, AJIB SHAADI KA MUJHKO MILA HAI YE TOHFA, YEH KISKI HOGAYI PAMAAL LAASH MAQTAL MEIN..

items.title: Ammu nahi aaye
items.body:
AMMU NAHI AAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE
THE SHAAM-O-SEHAR LAB PE SAKINA KE YEH NAALEY AMMU NAHI AAYE, DARIYA SE KOI MERE CHACHA JAAN KO BULAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE
KYO ROOTH GAYE MUJH SE MERE CHAHNE WALE AMMU NAHI AAYE, KIS HAAL MEIN MAIN HOO YEH BHI TO POOCHA NA KISI NE AMMU NAHI AAYE
HAR SIMTH SITAMGAAR HAI KOI NAHI MERA MAIN KYA KAROO BABA, FARIYAAD KARU BHI TO KARU BOLO MAIN KIS SE AMMU NAHI AAYE

AYE BABA MERE KANAO SE KHOO BEHTA HAI DEKHO TAKLEEF HAI MUJH KO, IS TARHA GOHAR SHIMR-E-SITAMGAAR NE CHEENEY AMMU NAHI AAYE
KYA KOI YAHA SAHEB-E-AULAD NAHI HAI YEH LOOG HAI KAISE, DETA NAHI KOI BHI YATEEMAO KO DILASA AMMU NAHI AAYE
BANDHI GAYI BAZU MEIN RASAN SHAAM-E-GARIBAA THE KAISE MUSALMAA, LOOTA GAYA ASBAAB JALAYE GAYE KHAIME AMMU NAHI AAYE
SAR BAAP KI GODI ME LIYE BOLI SAKINA DUSHWAAR HAI JEENA, BABA ZARA DEKHO MERE RUKHSAAR HAI NEELEY AMMU NAHI AAYE

ZINDAAN NAHI SHAAM KA YEH MAUT KA GHAR HAI LAGTA MUJHEY DAR HAI, GHUT GHUT KE KAYI MAR GAYE ZINDAAN ME BACHCHAY AMMU NAHI AAYE
DIL MEHAI KAYI DIN SE WATAN JAANE KA ARMAA KEHTI THI YE NADAA, AB KAUN CHUDAYE MUJEH ZINDAAN-E-BALA SE AMMU NAHI AAYE
CHUP HO GAYI SAHIL YAHI KEH KEH KE SAKINA MATAM HUVA BARPA, AMMU NAHI AAYE MERE AMMU NAHI AAYE AMMU NAHI AAYE

items.body:

Shabeer Ke Chehray Se Gham Door Karne Walay.
Tum Door Kar Do Aa Kar Abbas Gham Hamarey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Baab-e-Hawaij Ho Zainab Ka Sahara Ho.
Ho Fazal-o-Karam Hum Pe Tum Fazal Ke Baba Ho.
Hum Kis Se Madad Mangay Koi Nahi Hamara.
Bas Jee Rahe Hain Maula Hum Aap Ke Saharey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Milney Ke Liye Aaon Hasrat Hai Mere Dil Ki.
Na Rasta Aasaan Hai Na Zaad-e-Safar Koi.
Mushkil Yeh Meri Hal Ho Mushkil Kusha Ke Betay.
Aa Jaein Jald Hum Bhi Darbar Mein Tumhare.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Ghar Mein Azakhana Ro Ro Ke Sajatay Hain.
Yeh Kehte Hoye Momin Hathoon Ko Uthatay Hain.
Zahra Ki Dua Ho Tum Sun Lo Dua Hamari.
Aa Jao Mere Ghar Bhi Umm Ul-Baneen Ke Pyaray.
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam Ki Qasam Maula Seene Ka Sakoon Tum Ho.
Aye Qamar-e-Bani Hashim Ab Chain Miley Dil Ko.
Oss Bali Sakina Ki Ghurbat Ka Wasta Hai.
Kano Se Jis Ke Cheeney Zalim Ne Goshwaray.
<<DIVIDER>>
Andaz-e-Wafadari Dunya Ko Sikhatay Hain.
Woh Hath Rahein Baqi Parcham Jo Uthatay Hain.
Main Wasta Oss Pal Ka Deta Hoon Tum Ko Maula.
Kat Kar Girey They Bazu Jab Nehar Ke Kinaray.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Godiyaan Khali Hain Ab Jald Unhein Bhar Do.
Oss Maa Ke Waseelay Se Aoulad Atta Kar Do.
Jholay Se Lipat Kar Jo Kehti Thi Mere Asghar.
Tum Bin Rubab Kaisay Ab Zindagi Guzarey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar Shifa Paein Ho Jaein Reha Qaidi.
Sajjad Ki Ghurbat Ki Hai Tum Ko Qasam Ghazi.
Aabad Rahe Sar Pe Saya Tere Alam Ka.
Farsh-e-Aza Pe Aa Kar Ro Ro Ke Dil Pukarey.
<<DIVIDER>>
ZEESHANO RAZA Kyun Na Faryad Karein Tum Se.
Jab Zarbain Lagin Terah Shabeer Ki Gardan Pe.
Har Zarb Pe Maula Ne Ro Kar Tumhein Pukara.
Manzar Woh Yaad Kar Ke Rotay Hain Gham Ke Marey.

items.title: ZAQMI JO RAN ME QAASIM-E- GUL PAHRAHAN HUWA
items.body:
zaqmi jo ran me qaasim-e- gul paihrahan huwa
paida shahaana jode se range kafan huwa
bhaaghe jinaa'n rasool ko baitul hazan huwa
aur fouj-e- kee'n me shaad har ek tegh zan huwa
<<MINI>>
ghul tha ke round daala hai lashkar ke bagh ko

ghabraa gaye ye sun ke sada sarwar-e- anaam

aaya sooe yateem-e- hassan mout ka payaam

hamshakl-e- mustafa ko bulalo pukaar ke
maango duaa saro'n se amaame utaar ke

ye kehke qibla ru hue sultaan-e- kaayenath

aye qaaleq-e- zamee'n-o- zamaa'n rabb-e- paak zaath
in zalimou ke haath se qaasim ko de najaath

tu haafez-e- jahaa'n hai kareem -ur- raheem hai

zainab ne uth ke khol diye apne sar ke baal
seene me hil gaya dil-e- bano-e- qush qisaal

abid ka tap se garm badan sard ho gaya
qasim ke chote bhai ka mu zard ho gaya

chillayi roke zouja-e- abbas-e- noujawaa'n
ya rab hai tu yateem-e- hassan kaa nigaahbaa'n
sunkar ye ghul dulhan ke bhi aansu huwe rawaa'n
lekar balaaye'n saas pukaari ke meri jaa'n
<<MINI>>
qaaleq karega raham na aah-o- bukaa karo
dulha pa aa bani hai mai sadqe duaa karo
<<DIVIDER>>
is izteraab me jo sunaa saas ka suqan
zanu se sar uthaa ke huwi qibla roo dulhan
aahista ki ye arz ke aye rabb-e- zulmenan
dushman pa fat'ha yaab ho laqte dil -e- hassan

ladne gaye hai tishna dahan teri raah me
rakh mere ibn-e- amm ko tu apni panaah me

yaa rab dulhan bane mujhe guzri na ek shab
dulha jo margaya to mujhe kya kahenge sab
ab tak to sharm se na hilaaye the mai ne lab
par kya kahoo'n ke ab hai meri rooh par ta'ab
<<MINI>>
shabbar ke aaftab ka waqt-e ghuroob hai
dulha se pehle mujh ko uthaale to qoob hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sehre ke phool bhi abhi sookhe nahi hai aah
jo aagaya payaam randaape ka ya ilaah
ye aqd tha ke mout thi maatam tha ya ke byaah
baad iske hoga qalq me kyu'n kar mera nibaah
<<MINI>>
uthu'n jahaan se dilbar-e- shabbar ke saamne
aurat ki mout qoob hai shouhar ke saamne
<<DIVIDER>>
ghash me jhuka faras pa jo wo gheerat -o- qamar
maara kisi ne farq pa ek gurz taan kar
barchi lagi jo sheesh ki tukde huwa jigar
girte the asp se ke kamar par laga tabar
<<MINI>>
taareq ki tegh kha ke pukaare imaam ko
faryaad ya hussain bachalo ghulaam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
jhapte jo shaah fouj pa chamka ke zulfeqaar
bijli giri yazeed ke lashkar pa ek baar
is ghaiz me yamee'n se jo aaye sooe yasaar

<<MINI>>
bhagdadh me qoo'n se ran ki zamee'n laal hogayi

dekha imaam ne ke ragadte hain edhiyaa'n
sookhe huwe labo'n pa hai ainthi huwi zabaa'n
damaad se lipat gaye hazrat basad fughaa'n
be jaa'n huwa hussain ke aage wo neemjaa'n

jab laash uthaayi shah ne to choor isteqaan the

items.title: Abbas qatl hogaye tanha hue hussain
items.body:
ABBAS QATL HOGAYE TANHA HUE HUSSAIN, THAME KAMAR KO ROTA HAI ZEHRA KA NOOR-E-AIN
SHAANE KATE HUE HAI TOH SAR HAI SHIGAFTA, BHAI KE ZAKHM DEKHTE HAIN ROOTE HAIN HUSSAIN
SHEH SE SAKINA KEHTI THI ABBAS HAIN KAHAN, KAISE TASALLI DEIN USSE AB SHAHE MASHRAQAIN
PAANI NA MANGONGI KABHI AMMU AB AA BHI JAO, KARTI THI BAS YE PYAASI SAKINA TADAP KE BAIN

PARDE KA UNKE HAYE MOHAFIZ NAHI RAHA, MUSHKIL KUSHA KI BETIYAN KARTI HAIN SHOR-O-SHAIN
SUB KO DILASA DETI HAIN BINTE ALI MAGAR, KIS TARHA AYE ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR KE DIL KO CHAIN
BE DAST GHAZI GHODE SE KIS TARHA SE GIRA, MAIN LIKH RAHA HOON BINTE NABI KAR RAHI HAIN BAIN
UMMUL BANEEN KE LAAL PA ROTE HAIN HUM RASHEED, ZEHRA KE DIL KO MILTA HAI IN AANSUON SE CHAIN

BY Meer Babar Ali Anees (khuda e Sukhan)

items.title: Kounain me abbas ke matam ki sada hai
items.body:

MATAM SHAHE MAZLOOM KA ELAANE WAFA HAI, SHABBIR KE ZAKHOM KI DAWA ASKH-E-AZA HAI, ZAINAB KI TAMANNA HAI YE ZEHRA KI DUA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI

KAASA LIYE HAATHON MEIN BADI DAIE SE DAR PAR, HAI MUNTAZARE AAB SAKAINA MERI DUKHTAR, BEDAST ALAMDAR HAI MASHKEEZA CHHIDA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI

BAHAEIN HAI BHATEEJI KI JO GARDAN MEIN CHACHA KI, TASWEER NIGAOH MEIN HAI WO AHLE AZA KI, PARCHAM MEIN ALAMDAR KE MASHKEEZA BANDHA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI
ABBAS SE KEHTE THE SHAH-E-DEEN YE LIPAT KAR, KIS TARHA SE AB HAAL YE DEKHOON MAIEN BARADAR, SHAANE HAI QALAM AANHK MEIN EK TEER LAGA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI
KEHTE THE JIGAR THAAM KE SULTANE DO AALAM, TADPAEGAQHATOONE QAYAMAT KO YAHI GHAM, BEDAST JARI GHODE SE RETI PA GIRA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI
MAZHAR YE SADA AATI HAI HAR TASHNAGULU SE, TAHASHR ZAMANE MEIN SHAHEEDAON KE LAHOO SE, RAUSHAN HAR EK DAUR MEIN YE SHAMME AZA HAI, KAUNAIN MEIN ABBAS KE MATAM KI SADA HAI
